page: Microsoft Azure L96ps_v5 is a storage-optimized virtual machine based on the ARM64 architecture and managed by the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The system allocates 96 dedicated vCPUs paired with 768 GB of system memory, providing a consistent ratio of 8 GB of RAM per core. The instance contains zero discrete GPUs and does not provision default complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The storage profile is anchored by an integrated 23,040 GB local NVMe SSD array designed for high-capacity I/O demands. In addition to its large direct-attached NVMe storage, the instance supports Azure Premium Storage to allow scalable persistent volume attachment alongside the local scratch capacity.

Hardware resource distribution makes the L96ps_v5 suited for disk-bound, high-throughput applications. Dense dedicated ARM64 compute, coupled with 768 GB of RAM and over 23 TB of fast local NVMe storage, delivers strong qualitative hardware efficiency for large-scale distributed databases, NoSQL stores, transactional database engines, log analysis, and big data search indexing.
description: Microsoft Azure L96ps_v5 is a storage-optimized virtual machine operating on the 64-bit ARM architecture via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance features 96 dedicated vCPUs paired with 768 GB of system memory, maintaining an 8 GB per vCPU ratio. Local storage capabilities include an integrated 23,040 GB NVMe SSD array, complemented by support for Premium Storage volumes. Graphics acceleration is not included, with GPU allocation at zero, and complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not provisioned with the base instance. The pairing of extensive local solid-state capacity, high memory density, and 96 dedicated ARM cores delivers a hardware configuration optimized for high-throughput, latency-sensitive applications. Workload applicability includes large distributed NoSQL databases, search indexing engines, transactional databases, and big data analytics pipelines requiring massive direct-attached storage.
